intent.proves: Every active product and variant in the default language and in scope has a product number; a master with variant groups is exempt.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global.

bindings.reason: Requires complete joins and raw/fallback semantics parity before this binding may execute.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomProducts p WHERE p.ProductLanguageId = N'{lang}' AND ISNULL(p.ProductNumber, N'') = N'' AND p.ProductActive = 1{inScope} AND (ISNULL(p.ProductVariantId, N'') <> N'' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomVariantGroupProductRelation v WHERE v.VariantGroupProductRelationProductId = p.ProductId))
